svg.title: A ContinuousState is a timeline per entity
svg.desc: The ContinuousStateToSchedule test drawn as swimlanes: AGV-1 drives 10->9->11 in six seconds; AGV-2 waits at 6, then drives 6->9->12. Each bar is one Motion. The action DAG built from it orders AGV-2's entry into node 9 after AGV-1 has left it.
